mentions.name: Haskell Brain Teasers
mentions.description: Haskell Brain Teasers is a puzzle-focused book that uses each puzzle as a launchpad for discussing how to reason about programs, design tradeoffs, and nuances around maintainability. It is shorter and leans more advanced than the author's first book, Effective Haskell, and avoids simple gotcha questions.
